description_en: Queries the effective priority range for access control policies in a specified VPC firewall policy group
description_zh: 查询指定VPC防火墙策略组访问控制策略优先级生效范围
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-vpc-firewall-policy-prior-used --lang zh --vpc-firewall-id vfw-a42bbb7b887148c90000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVpcFirewallPolicyPriorUsed

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the policy group for the VPC firewall. Call the [DescribeVpcFirewallAclGroupList](~~159760~~) operation to query the ID.

Valid values:

- If the VPC firewall protects a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance, set this parameter to the ID of the CEN instance.

  Example: cen-ervw0g12b5jbw\*\*\*\*
- If the VPC firewall protects an Express Connect circuit, set this parameter to the ID of the VPC firewall instance.

  Example: vfw-a42bbb7b887148c9\*\*\*\*
parameters.description_zh:
VPC边界防火墙的访问控制策略组ID。您可调用[DescribeVpcFirewallAclGroupList](~~159760~~)接口获取该ID。

取值：

- VPC边界防火墙防护云企业网时，策略组ID使用云企业网实例ID。

  例如cen-ervw0g12b5jbw*\*\*\*

- VPC边界防火墙防护高速通道时，策略组ID使用VPC边界防火墙实例ID。

   例如vfw-a42bbb7b887148c9*\*\*\*
